name: workplace-presentation
description: Sovereign offline presentation tool — PointSav Digital Systems
author: PointSav Digital Systems

_notes.tauri-version: Tauri v1.7.x is used for macOS 10.13 High Sierra compatibility. Tauri v2 requires macOS 10.15+. When the development machine is upgraded, bump @tauri-apps/cli and @tauri-apps/api to 2.x and update src-tauri/Cargo.toml accordingly.
_notes.runtime-api-access: The frontend (src/) does not import '@tauri-apps/api' at runtime — it calls the window.__TAURI__ global exposed by tauri.conf.json's build.withGlobalTauri, since there is no bundler in this project (distDir serves src/ directly). @tauri-apps/api is kept as a devDependency for editor typing/IntelliSense and to match the versions already pinned in package-lock.json.
